metadata.author: by Melina Merchant / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: 1995 film set on the Hoggetts' sheep farm
1979 miniseries with Robert Duvall in the title role
Member of the oldest federal law enforcement agency
Ranch animal with an uneven hide?
Serving that doesn't even moisten your cornflakes?
Precinct boss with a hoarse cough?
One might get thrown from a horse
Drink akin to a Cape Codder
Trees that produce a light honey
Dog that smells like cheap wine?
Philanthropist Charles for whom a Northwestern library is named
Treated a stain, in a way
It should stop a run on the banks
It opens a lot of doors
It's over twice as tall as Vesuvius
They may be on a roll
